answer: Reaching eligibility takes 50 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. The voyage register is checked at draw time, thread lists the eligible set, and velvet seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 50 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 36 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
